description.value: Siegel's Bagels is an authentic Montreal-style bagel shop with a location inside Granville Island Public Market, one of Vancouver's most-visited culinary destinations. The shop serves bagels in-store and also offers home delivery, national shipping, and catering. Its setting within the Public Market makes it a natural food stop for cyclists exploring the Granville Island area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 45m; rack (100 spaces) at 56m. Total: 100 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /pages/visit-us subpage confirms the Granville Island location at 1689 Johnston St #22, Vancouver, BC V6H 3R9 with phone (604) 685-5670, both matching the OSM record. The site confirms the business is active (© 2026, active Shopify store with products for sale). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Website lists a second location in Kitsilano (1883 Cornwall Ave, Vancouver, BC V6J 1C7, phone 604-737-8151) that does not appear to correspond to this OSM record; it may warrant its own separate WWC listing.
OSM address omits the postal code; the more complete form from the website is 1689 Johnston St #22, Vancouver, BC V6H 3R9.
Category assigned as 'Groceries' via shop=bakery tag, but this is a specialty bagel shop — consider recategorizing as a food/cafe stop.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Montreal-style bagel shop inside Granville Island Public Market, a high-traffic stop on Vancouver's cycling routes — a practical and popular food stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A specialty bagel bakery is not a grocery store; a 'Food' or 'Bakery/Cafe' category would better represent this business for touring cyclists seeking a food stop rather than supplies.
